blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House impeachment team adviser and spokesperson Ace Barbers and Manila Rep. Bienvenido Abante Jr. on Friday rejected a warning from Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp that lowering the conviction threshold in her impeachment trial could allow the government to target senator-judges and influence the outcome. Duterte spokesperson Salvador Paolo Panelo Jr. had warned that excluding senators who are unable to participate from the denominator could give those in power an incentive to go after senators they expect to vote against their preferred outcome. “If the denominator, this 16, can be lowered, you are inviting those in power, the […]...
